fullContentHtml:
Patna High Court Assistant Admit Card 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : High Court of Judicial at Patna (Bihar) has released the admit card for the post of Ex-Cadre Assistant (Group-C). This recruitment was released for 68 posts. Applications for the Patna High Court Assistant Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 28 July 2026, to 27 August 2026. The written examination is going to be conducted on 18 September 2026. Candidates who had applied this form can check their Patna High Court Assistant Admit Card 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 28 July 2026
  • Last Date : 27 August 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 30 August 2026
  • Exam Date : 18 September 2026
  • Admit Card : 12 September 2026

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, EBC, BC : Rs. 1500/-
  • SC, ST : Rs. 750/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

How to Download Admit Card

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the admit card / hall ticket link.
  3. Enter your registration number / roll number and date of birth / password.
  4. Click on submit to view your admit card.
  5. Download and take a printout. Carry it to the exam center along with a photo ID.

Patna High Court Assistant Admit Card 2026 is a government exam related notification. Complete details including important dates, fee, eligibility and links are provided above.

The last date to apply is 27 August 2026.
